title: Read/Write Multiple Registers payload exchange
purpose: Cover FC17 field interaction with separate read and write ranges, a variable-length write payload, and a matching read response.
expected_behavior: The server may process the two-register write range at 0020 and return four bytes for the two-register read range at 0010, retaining transaction identifier 0202 and unit identifier 7f.
constraints_preserved: request MBAP length 000f matches unit plus fourteen-byte FC17 PDU
write byte count 04 matches two register values
response MBAP length 0007 matches unit plus response byte count and data
transaction identifier and unit identifier match across the exchange
issue_safety_notes: This is a structurally diverse model-prior seed for field interaction; validity is not externally verified and it makes no vulnerability or issue claim.
